question: List all movies.
sql: SELECT * FROM movies;

question: Show the titles of all movies.
sql: SELECT title FROM movies;

question: List movies released after 2010.
sql: SELECT title, release_year FROM movies WHERE release_year > 2010;

question: Find movies with rating greater than 8.
sql: SELECT m.title, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating FROM movies m JOIN reviews r ON m.id = r.movie_id GROUP BY m.id, m.title HAVING AVG(r.rating) > 8;

question: Show movies released in 2023.
sql: SELECT * FROM movies WHERE release_year = 2023;

question: List movies longer than 120 minutes.
sql: SELECT m.title FROM movies m WHERE m.duration_minutes > 120;",

question: Find directors from the United States.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT d.full_name FROM movie_directors md JOIN directors d ON md.director_id = d.id WHERE d.country = 'United States';

question: Show actors from the United Kingdom.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT d.full_name FROM movie_directors md JOIN directors d ON md.director_id = d.id WHERE d.country = 'United Kingdom';

question: List all movie genres.
sql: SELECT name FROM genres;

question: Find movies with rating between 7 and 9.
sql: SELECT m.title, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating FROM movies m JOIN reviews r ON m.id = r.movie_id GROUP BY m.id, m.title HAVING AVG(r.rating) BETWEEN 7 AND 9;

question: List movies directed by Christopher Nolan.
sql: SELECT m.title FROM movies m JOIN movie_directors md ON m.id = md.movie_id JOIN directors d ON md.director_id = d.id WHERE d.full_name = 'Christopher Nolan';

question: Show movie titles with their director names.
sql: SELECT m.title, d.full_name AS director_name FROM movies m JOIN movie_directors md ON m.id = md.movie_id JOIN directors d ON md.director_id = d.id;

question: List movies in the Action genre.
sql: SELECT m.title FROM movies m JOIN movie_genres mg ON m.id = mg.movie_id JOIN genres g ON mg.genre_id = g.id WHERE g.name = 'Action';

question: Find all actors who acted in Inception.
sql: SELECT a.full_name FROM actors a JOIN movie_actors ma ON a.id = ma.actor_id JOIN movies m ON ma.movie_id = m.id WHERE m.title = 'Inception';

question: Show the genres of the movie Interstellar.
sql: SELECT g.name FROM genres g JOIN movie_genres mg ON g.id = mg.genre_id JOIN movies m ON mg.movie_id = m.id WHERE m.title = 'Interstellar';

question: List movies and their average review scores.
sql: SELECT m.title, AVG(r.rating) AS average_score FROM movies m JOIN reviews r ON m.id = r.movie_id GROUP BY m.id, m.title;

question: Find movies reviewed by John Smith.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT m.title FROM movies m JOIN reviews r ON m.id = r.movie_id JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE u.full_name = 'John Smith';

question: List actors and their roles in The Dark Knight.
sql: SELECT a.full_name, ma.role_name FROM actors a JOIN movie_actors ma ON a.id = ma.actor_id JOIN movies m ON ma.movie_id = m.id WHERE m.title = 'The Dark Knight';

question: Show movies directed by directors from the United Kingdom.
sql: SELECT m.title, d.full_name FROM movies m JOIN movie_directors md ON m.id = md.movie_id JOIN directors d ON md.director_id = d.id WHERE d.country = 'United Kingdom';

question: List action movies released after 2015.
sql: SELECT m.title FROM movies m JOIN movie_genres mg ON m.id = mg.movie_id JOIN genres g ON mg.genre_id = g.id WHERE g.name = 'Action' AND m.release_year > 2015;
